name: simple-mod-marketplace
description: My collection of Claude Code mods for model routing, plugin auditing, usage meter, loop checking and permission explanation

plugins.name: prompt-model-suggester
plugins.description: Suggests a model before prompt execution and lets you confirm or change it

plugins.name: plugin-auditor
plugins.description: Side pane that audits installed plugins and shows which are useful

plugins.name: permission-explainer
plugins.description: Explains what permission requests actually mean in plain English

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Shows the 5 hour and Weekly usage, it also warn you when the chat is getting expensive

plugins.name: loop-timer
plugins.description: Shows the loop timer when set, and it let you manage it to some extent
